R3 and R2 (./path for find, the arm on -x, ! and ( ) taken. LS3 restored: 114 mutants plus DG. W2, a CARGO_TARGET_DIR holding a newline, is pre-0139 and goes into 0148, CONFIRMED: one issue for fullcycle's reading of CARGO_TARGET_DIR, relative or multi-line, and 0148 ships in 0.1.8 after 0139. Same rule on the seventh pass. Box clear; ask for START when it converges. 0147 is going to v2 on hv's ruling, report half only: hv ruled the profile-aware check verb out of 0.1.8 and left it to ST0006 WP-02.
